2026_01_NO_DET.headline: New Orleans’ front and backfield absences put Detroit in position to control the pace
2026_01_NO_DET.paragraph1: New Orleans heads to Detroit with Cameron Jordan, Oscar Delp and Audric Estimé ruled out and Alvin Kamara questionable, while the Lions list only a cornerback as questionable. Detroit can use that availability edge to stay physical, keep the Saints defending long possessions and attack an edge rotation missing Jordan. New Orleans needs to protect field position, manufacture efficient touches if Kamara is limited and prevent Detroit from turning steady early-down success into a one-sided tempo game.
2026_01_NO_DET.model_rationale: Detroit can use its healthier roster to sustain pressure across long possessions, while New Orleans needs efficient early-down offense and disciplined defense to keep the pace manageable.
